system.notes: SR2E p.154. Raises one Physical or Mental Attribute, or Reaction, by +3 while sustained. TN = 2 × the Attribute's rating; one success suffices; +4 TN if the Attribute is already magically boosted (e.g. a physical adept). Each Attribute is its own spell (learn e.g. Increase Strength +3: rename the copy). Doesn't affect an Attribute changed by cyberware (use Increase Cybered [Attribute]) and doesn't stack with another Increase spell on the same Attribute. Increase Reaction +3: Drain one level higher, ((F / 2) + 1)D; it raises only the Reaction Rating.

effects.name: Increase [Attribute] +3
effects.description: Adds +3 to the chosen Attribute while sustained. Change the key to the Attribute cast on (system.body.mod, system.strength.mod, system.reaction.mod, ...).
